# Federal Reserve Board

> > The Federal Reserve Board serves as the central banking authority of the United States, providing monetary policy guidance, financial system oversight, and public education on central banking operations.

The Federal Reserve Board website offers comprehensive information about the nation's central banking system, including organizational structure, leadership, monetary policy decisions, economic data, and banking regulations. Key leadership includes Chair Jerome H. Powell, Vice Chair Michael S. Barr, and Board members Michelle W. Bowman, Philip N. Jefferson, Lisa D. Cook, and Stephen I. Miran.

## Key Topics

- Federal Reserve Board
- Federal Reserve System

- Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC)

## Organization & Leadership

- [About the Fed](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed.htm): Overview of Federal Reserve System structure and Board leadership
- [Board Members](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/bios/board/default.htm): Biographies of Federal Reserve Board of Governors members
- [Federal Reserve Banks](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/federal-reserve-system.htm): Overview of Federal Reserve Banks and district organization
- [Federal Reserve System Boards of Directors](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/directors/about.htm): Federal Reserve System governance and boards of directors structure
- [Advisory Councils](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/advisorydefault.htm): Federal Reserve advisory councils including Community and Federal councils

## News, Events & Calendar

- [Calendar](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/calendar.htm): FOMC meetings, Board meetings, and statistical release calendar
- [Recent Postings](https://www.federalreserve.gov/recentpostings.htm): Recent Federal Reserve news, enforcement actions, and regulatory notices
- [RSS Feeds](https://www.federalreserve.gov/feeds/feeds.htm): RSS feed subscriptions for Fed content including monetary policy and research

## Publications & Research

- [Publications](https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications.htm): Directory of Federal Reserve publications including Beige Book and research
- [The Fed Explained](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/the-fed-explained.htm): Educational overview of central banking and Federal Reserve roles
- [The Fed Explained - Who We Are](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/fedexplained/who-we-are.htm): Educational guide explaining Federal Reserve organizational structure

## Support & Services

- [Contact](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/contact-us-topics.htm): Contact information for consumer complaints, fraud, and FOIA requests
- [FAQs](https://www.federalreserve.gov/faqs.htm): Frequently asked questions about Federal Reserve operations and services
- [Email Subscriptions](https://www.federalreserve.gov/subscribe.htm): Email subscription service for Fed Bulletin and statistical releases
- [Careers](https://www.federalreserve.gov/careers.htm): Federal Reserve employment opportunities and job search information

## Optional

- [Site Map](https://www.federalreserve.gov/sitemap.htm): Website navigation and organizational structure overview
